newsitem.title: USA: Typhoon Tina off Philippines, may threaten Japan.
newsitem.headline: Typhoon Tina off Philippines, may threaten Japan.

text.p: Typhoon Tina may threaten Japan, private forecaster Weather Services Corp said.

The typhoon has top winds of 85 mph and is currently northeast of Luzon, Philippines. The northeastern tip of Luzon as well as the eastern shores of Taiwan may feel some fringe-effects from the storm as it turns to the north during the next 36 hours.

These areas may see a few rain squalls, gusty winds, and some rough surf. Tina is expected to track to the north then north northeast. It should have top winds over 100 mph when it moves close to or over Okinawa late Wednesday, local time. It may then hit southern Japan near Kyushu by late Thursday.
